rows.question: Write a piece of continuous prose in Russian (140 words) in answer to ONE of the following. In your answer make sure to include ALL the points listed. You may use vocabulary and turns of phrases from texts in other sections of the examination paper, but marks will not be awarded for segments of your essay which replicate word for word segments from examination texts. 1. LETTER Write a letter to your pen-pal about a concert or a music festival that you recently attended. In your letter make reference to the following: • Where the concert/festival took place • How you got there • Who went with you • Your impresssions: share your thoughts and feelings about the concert/festival. OR Write the cover letter to accompany your CV in order to apply for a summer job. In your letter make reference to the following: • Why you want this job • What experience you have • What skills/qualities you bring to this position. 2. NARRATIVE (a) Write a review of your favourite book or film. OR (b) Write an account of an amusing episode from your childhood. 3. DISCUSSION (a) Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city. OR (b) Discuss the challenges of choosing a career.

rows.reason: Guided/extended writing: one six-option printed choice under a shared content/expression/task grid.
